name: FP-LAD
summary: FP-LAD, also known as fluoro-PRO-LAD, PROF-LAD, or TRALA-16, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD; METH-LAD). It is specifically a fluorinated derivative of PRO-LAD (6-propyl-6-nor-LSD) and an analogue of FLUORETH-LAD (FE-LAD; 6-ethyl-6-nor-LSD).
